description: Step back from something. 'withdraw_request' takes back an introduction your person asked for. 'withdraw_interest' steps out of one they said yes to, and works right up until contact is released. 'block_pair' stops these two cards being matched or introduced again. 'take_card_down' withdraws your person's card. Every one is two steps and terminal once done.

approved_digest.description: The approved_digest the preview returned, after the principal approved that exact content.

confirm.description: Send it. Requires approved_digest from the preview.
